visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man wearing a black baseball cap and a floral shirt stands inside a brightly lit car showroom, positioned between a black and a white Mercedes-Benz. He holds some papers and looks directly into the lens. (2) Close-up shots reveal him wearing a large gold chain and multiple beaded bracelets as he gestures excitedly with his hands while talking. (3) He presents a small electronic paint thickness gauge to the camera and then displays a series of vehicle inspection reports, including Carfax and Rheinland certificates. (4) Detailed close-ups show the man pointing to specific stickers on the car door frame and comparing a VIN number on a contract to the one etched on the car's body. (5) The scene transitions to a car repair shop where a white Mercedes is raised on a hydraulic lift. The man uses a handheld flashlight to illuminate the underside of the car. (6) He points at the chassis components while explaining details, moving the light to show various parts of the undercarriage. (7) He looks back at the camera while still under the car, continuing his explanation with high energy. (8) The final scene shows a blue and white graphic end screen with corporate branding.
